2. According to the text data, the filming location for the movie "Snow White and the Huntsman" was in the United Kingdom. Specifically, the beach scenes were predominantly filmed in Pembrokeshire, on the Marloes Sands beach near the village of Marloes between September 26 and 29, 2011.
